'''François Jacques "Francesc" Soulié''' (born 22 March 1978) is an [[Andorra]]n [[cross-country skiing (sport)|cross-country skier]] who has competed since 1999. Competing in two [[Winter Olympics]], he earned his best finish of 47th in the 50 km event at [[Vancouver]] in [[2010 Winter Olympics|2010]].<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/so/francesc-soulie-1.html |title=Francesc Soulié |quote=Full name: François Jacques Soulié |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131030213411/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/so/francesc-soulie-1.html |archive-date=30 October 2013 }}</ref>

Soulié's best finish at the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships]] was 51st in the team sprint at [[Sapporo]] in [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2007|2007]].

His best World Cup finish was 24th in the team sprint at the [[China]] in 2007.
